mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an imminent monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 5.9% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, increasing recession risk and leading to negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal fails to produce a statistically significant negative return (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous contraction in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, increasing the likelihood of a near-term economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 104.5 (index 2017=100) over two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, increasing the probability of a recession and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 104.5, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in CPIAUCSL above 237.5 and a decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past four months indicates stagflationary pressures, prompting central bank hawkishness and reducing equity risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of high inflation and declining GDP fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 140,000 thousand in a single month signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 140000, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.1% combined with a declining CPIAUCSL indicates a disinflationary monetary tightening, reducing inflation expectations and lowering real rates, which supports equity valuations and drives positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising rates and falling inflation fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction (HOUST) above 1,020 thousand units, combined with rising real spending (RSAFS), signals strong household demand and a rebound in consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
